{{Top|leg}}
'''Isham''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While serving as a guard with five others, Isham was attacked by an assailant armed with [[zenji needle]]s. Isham was the only survivor, and spent [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] healing in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]]. Isham related the story on the entry for zenji needles in the Datalog.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
